recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a male subject sitting on industrial metal stairs, characterized by a warm, sepia-washed color palette and textured, distressed typography layered across the mid-section.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against repetitive horizontal lines of stairs
Warm peach-toned background contrasting with cool blue denim
Distressed, large-scale display text overlapping the subject's torso
Soft, diffused lighting creating a low-contrast, nostalgic atmosphere
coreInvariants: Warm sepia or peach color cast

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally positioned, occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame in a seated pose.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large, dark-colored display text across the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move down to the large display text, then follow the horizontal lines of the stairs outward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Balanced negative space provided by the repetitive stair treads above and to the sides of the subject.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high brightness; values are compressed to create a soft, faded look.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones and muted blues

letterConstructionRules: Rough, eroded edges simulating weathered paint
characterSpecificRedesigns: Irregular 'nibbled' edges on all glyphs to suggest age
Slightly uneven baseline for a hand-stamped feel
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large distressed display font paired with a small, clean, widely-spaced geometric sans-serif for contrast.
graphicDevices: Horizontal stair lines acting as a grid
Subtle vignette to focus on the center

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weathered, rustic feel of the primary text.
Provides the clean, modern contrast needed for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a man with blonde hair wearing a white paisley button-down shirt and blue jeans, sitting on industrial metal diamond-plate stairs. The entire image has a warm, sepia-toned, slightly faded 2000s film aesthetic. Soft lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, dark purple, distressed condensed sans-serif text across the middle. Below it, add a smaller line of clean black geometric sans-serif text with very wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette warm and sepia-toned?
Does the main text have a weathered, eroded texture?
Is the subject centered on the stairs?
Is the subtitle text widely tracked?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distress on the typography
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the subject's face.
Verify the stair texture is visible through the color wash.
Check that the distressed edges of the font look intentional, not pixelated.
Confirm the wide tracking of the subtitle is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered lifestyle portrait on a textured industrial background with a warm sepia overlay and a two-tier typographic hierarchy featuring a large distressed display font and a small, wide-tracked clean sans-serif.
